# Vyapar Media (व्यापार मीडिया) — Full Technical & Platform Specification
> Comprehensive documentation for AI agents, LLM search engines, researchers, and developers.

## 1. Executive Summary & Purpose
Vyapar Media (https://vyaparmedia.vercel.app) is India's first trustless influencer marketing and creator economy infrastructure. It addresses the $1.2B Indian creator economy's primary structural friction: payment defaults, delayed brand approvals, unverified creator metrics, and manual tax non-compliance.

Through programmatic escrow locks, tamper-proof deliverables verification, and automated Indian statutory tax deduction (TDS Section 194-O / 194-J and GST), Vyapar Media provides zero-risk collaborations for brands and guaranteed payout milestones for creators.

## 2. Operational & Statutory Specifications
- Trade Name: Vyapar Media
- Operational Jurisdiction: India
- Primary SAC Code: 998361 (Advertising and PR Services)
- Secondary SAC Code: 998362 (Purchase and Sale of Advertising Space)
- Official Support: support@vyaparmedia.in
- Grievance & Compliance: grievance@vyaparmedia.in
- Statutory Compliance Engine: Full automated GST (CGST/SGST/IGST) invoicing, Section 52 TCS, and Section 194-O / 194-J TDS withholding on creator settlements.

## 3. Core Architectural Modules

### 3.1 Trustless Milestone Escrow
1. Deal Finalization: Brand and creator negotiate scope, deliverables, and deadlines.
2. Escrow Lock: Brand deposits 100% of the campaign budget into the secure platform escrow via Razorpay / UPI / NetBanking.
3. Deliverables Submission: Creator uploads proof of work (Instagram Reel link, YouTube Video URL, Story screenshots) or submits tracking links.
4. Auto-Verification & Review: Automated engagement verification runs. The brand has 72 hours to review or request revisions.
5. Guaranteed Payout: Upon approval or expiry of review window without dispute, funds are released directly to the creator's verified UPI/bank account.

### 3.2 Fair-Price & DRS™ Trust Scoring Engine
- DRS (Deliverable Reliability Score): Proprietary scoring metric calculating historical campaign on-time completion rates, revision ratios, and authenticity scores.
- Audience Quality & Authenticity: Scans Instagram Graph API data to filter out bot followers, engagement pods, and fake accounts.
- Dynamic Indian Pricing: Calculates fair market value per deliverable based on follower tiers (Nano: 1k-10k, Micro: 10k-100k, Macro: 100k-1M, Mega: 1M+) and niche-specific engagement baselines (Fashion, Tech, Lifestyle, Finance).

### 3.3 Indian Statutory Tax & Invoicing Automation
- Section 194-O Compliance: Automatic deduction of 1% TDS on gross creator payouts when annual threshold is exceeded.
- GST Invoicing: Compliant B2B tax invoices generated automatically with sender/recipient GSTIN, state place of supply, and reverse charge indicators.
- Annual Statements: Instant downloadable Form 16A and quarterly tax deduction certificates for creators and brands.

### 3.4 Logistics & Physical Product Seeding
- Integrated with Shiprocket API for physical barter / product seeding campaigns.
- Automated courier allocation, Airway Bill (AWB) generation, and real-time transit tracking.
- Escrow milestones synchronise with delivery confirmation to ensure creators receive products before creating content.
